snippet.title: Halls of Torment - 1.0 Full Release Date Trailer - Coming out 24 September
snippet.description:
Get Halls of Torment on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2218750/Halls_of_Torment/

After 16 months on Early Access and with a community of almost a million players, the 1.0 version of Halls of Torment will launch this September 24 on Steam at a full price of 6.66 EUR|USD and with a release discount of 25% during the first week after launch. Halls of Torment is a casual roguelite action rpg presented in a pre rendered retro look reminiscent of RPGs from the late 90s. Choose one of 11 hero characters and descend into the deadly Halls of Torment. Fight unholy horrors from beyond and survive wave after wave until you face one of the tormented lords. Advance your hero with character traits, abilities, and items. Create a new powerful build during each run. Explore various underground expanses and find new powerful items that enable you to venture even deeper into the abyss!
